title: QPB harness terminal result
description: Per-job terminal result the harness writes to results/result-NNNNN.json when it sees a terminal heartbeat sentinel. Derived from the terminal heartbeat line + job_manifest + run-dir stats. A2A-ready: schema_version + task_id + UUID typing.

repo.description: Absolute path or URL of the target repo (copied from job_manifest).

status.description: Terminal status copied from the worker's terminal heartbeat sentinel.

result_file.description: Absolute path to the worker's terminal artifact (typically quality/SUMMARY.md or quality/BUGS.md). Copied from the terminal heartbeat's result_file field.

duration_sec.description: Wall-clock seconds from dispatched_at to terminal heartbeat ts.

total_heartbeats.description: Count of lines in heartbeat.ndjson (progress + terminal).

summary.description: One-line outcome from the terminal heartbeat's summary field.
